items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: Dick Mariani, yeah, I think they had equal level of talent... I think my Uncle Dick took my mother and maybe a couple of my aunts on one of his gigs

ctx.x: Well you had not only your father was musical but also your uncle also?

Dick Mariani, yeah, I think they had equal level of talent, which was, in my estimation a high level, both of them. So I’m not sure which side of the family I got the genes from, assuming I have any genes that are with musical talent. But I got it. Yeah, that’s how my mother met my father. My mother and my aunts used to be sort of like in groupies because they came with the band in the big band era in the thirties and forties.
